# Columns
#   Date          YYYY/MM/DD with a four-digit year (no MM-DD shorthand).
#   Event_Name    Free text shown in reports; may be left empty.
#   Event_Factor  Demand multiplier: 1.00 = neutral
#                 Must be greater than 0. Usual range 0.50 - 3.00; values
#                 outside it still load but produce a [WARN] line.
#   Category      Public Holiday | Special Event | School Holiday | Custom

# Rules

#   - Only dates inside the 90-day pricing window are priced.
#   - A one-off row (Recurring=N) overrides a recurring row on the same date
#     even if the one-off row appears earlier in the file.
#   - Among rows of the SAME kind
